description.value: Tsimshian Storm is a community-owned passenger and freight ferry connecting Prince Rupert (Metlakatla Ferry Dock) to Kitkatla, with stops serving Hartley Bay and Oona River. Departs Prince Rupert twice weekly at 10am, returning from Kitkatla at noon; sailings are weather-dependent. Adult fare is $33, senior/child $23, plus 5% GST on freight (first 40 lbs free, then $0.15/lb). Kitkatla has no road network, so cyclists would be transiting through rather than riding locally. The operator has not published a bicycle policy — call ahead to confirm.
